title: Fur Bundles for the Shopkeeper
summary: Tuck Pikeman wants 3 fur bundles from the watch post taken to Norah Tolliver before the watch changes at dusk, and then a word.
offer_text: "We need fur bundles, and what is stacked at the watch post is the town's to take. Carry it to Norah Tolliver before the watch changes at dusk, then come and tell me."
turn_in_text: "Good. That is one thing in Wolfsend that goes right."

objectives.text: Take 3 fur bundles from the pile
Hand the fur bundles to Norah Tolliver
Tell Tuck Pikeman it is done

relationship.label: Ran an errand for the town
